name: designer
description: Designer workbench for code-first design/UX decision & quality assurance across Claude Code & Codex CLI (ADR-0042). The third L3 persona after engineer and founder: the six universal cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine) re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow — pre-code design thinking (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture) plus a post-code quality-critique loop that evaluates rendered screenshots + frontend code under usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses, with accessibility a candidate-only veto gate. Workflow machinery, hooks, all six verb surfaces, the 7-axis design decision registry, the design-anchored ensemble protocol, the designer:start lifecycle macro, the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills, and the L4 design profiles (general / flow / ui / cta / content) — all shipped (ADR-0042 Accepted). Composes the image L2 capability for generated imagery rather than re-implementing it (designer never calls an image generation API); Figma and external design tools are excluded in v1 (code-first scope).

interface.shortDescription: Code-first design/UX decision & quality workbench — the six verb skills, the designer:start single-deliverable lifecycle macro with approval gates at the direction and the spec, the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills, the shared Design Task Profile + design-anchored ensemble protocol, and the L4 design profiles (general / flow / ui / cta / content) mapped to their decision presets; accessibility the veto gate throughout, vision host-direct, the peer path code/text-only (the third L3 persona; ADR-0042 Accepted)
interface.longDescription: L3 persona plugin for code-first design/UX — the third L3 persona after engineer and founder (ADR-0042). Exposes the six universal cognitive verbs as canonical skills re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow, each invokable as $designer:<verb>: investigate (the design-brief profile — scans UX/accessibility standards, design systems, competitor UX, and the design press across a 5-tier source taxonomy, reads the existing frontend code, and produces a durable cited design brief), frame (a UX problem model with users, job-to-be-done, goals, MEASURABLE UX success metrics, constraints, and key risks), decide (a 7-axis design decision registry — usability plus an archetype axis decisive, accessibility a veto gate, SD3), compose (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture, and component specs annotated with accessibility + consistency acceptance criteria, SD2), critique (the post-code quality-assurance differentiator, SD4: usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses that hold a pre-code design spec or a post-code rendered screenshot + frontend code to a single internalized quality-criteria reference, accessibility a candidate-only veto gate), and refine (the critique -> refine -> re-critique bounded convergence loop, never clearing a usability/conversion problem by opening a new accessibility barrier). The persona surface is complete (ADR-0042 Accepted): $designer:start, the single-deliverable lifecycle macro that sequences all six verbs in-place with user-approval gates at the direction (Phase 1) and the spec (Phase 2), guards the terminal write behind Phase 4 convergence, and ends in an artifact handoff to the frontend rather than a dispatch or an auto-commit; the $designer:resume / $designer:checkpoint / $designer:peer-now meta skills (drift report + archive, SessionStart re-injection, and a genericized side-channel peer probe); the shared skills/_shared/references/orchestration.md (the canonical Design Task Profile, bilingual EN/KO trigger convention, the L4 profile -> decision-preset map, and the image L2 artifact-handoff boundary) and skills/_shared/references/ensemble-protocol.md (six design-anchored ensemble point types — reference-scan / frame / brainstorm / plan-verify / review / refine-verify); and the L4 design profiles general / flow / ui / cta / content, each resolving to a decision preset defined in the SD3 registry. Vision is host-direct on the active host (Claude natively, Codex via codex exec --image) while the cross-host companion peer path carries no image channel at all, so peer verification stays code/text and a vision-grounded claim without a host-direct read is reported UNVERIFIED. designer is non-dispatch (ADR-0042 Non-Goal 2) and composes the image L2 capability rather than re-implementing imagery — it never calls an image generation API; Figma is excluded in v1. Bidirectional companion ensembles (Claude <-> Codex) dispatch automatically at command-mode phase boundaries under an always-max policy, behind an explicit privacy gate in which screenshots are sensitive by default. Codex skills provide cognitive-runbook parity, not host-bootstrap/state parity (ADR-0042 SD1 / ADR-0021 boundary).
defaultPrompt: $designer:investigate Research navigation patterns for a mobile web checkout flow and produce a cited design brief
$designer:frame Shape this checkout redesign into a UX problem model with measurable success metrics
$designer:decide Compare a bottom tab bar vs a hamburger menu for this mobile app's primary navigation
$designer:compose Draft the checkout flow spec — per-screen states + CTA copy — with accessibility + consistency acceptance criteria
$designer:critique Review this checkout screen (screenshot + frontend code) across the usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses
$designer:refine Apply these critique findings to the checkout screen and re-critique to confirm no new accessibility barrier
$designer:start Take this checkout flow from references to a reviewed, accessibility-gated spec in one pass
